purpose: Repair the measured long-form exposure gap in the existing capability cakes without changing the frozen English transformer, classifier, ABI, symbolic substrate, imported artifact, or source model.

triggering_evidence.finding: Turning the cake off after the first output decision recovered 18.64 percent of token count, localizing the remaining drift to long-form cake exposure rather than tokenizer coverage or transformer weights.

trajectory_data.teacher: sealed LayerCake English parent, not an external source LLM
trajectory_data.source_prompts: First 128 records from the immutable train-only calibration evidence, retaining the same hash order and long-form suffix.
trajectory_data.curriculum_construction: Replace exactly those 128 train rows in a copied curriculum with the transformed prompt and sealed-parent autonomous response; preserve all 1,972 remaining train rows and all 420 instruction-validation rows byte-semantically.

locked_training.trainable: existing task cakes and existing training-only LoRA state only
locked_training.frozen: transformer base, task classifier, symbolic substrate, ABI, imported ABIX

execution_and_stop_rule.after_training: Run the 1,400-row ABI validation and 420-row held-out general validation on the PyTorch host before native export.
execution_and_stop_rule.native_screen: Export the exact repaired host, derive the already-proved dynamic train-output prompt-union graph, and run the unchanged 1,024-byte sustained benchmark.
execution_and_stop_rule.promotion: Only continue to full headline, physical, identity, adversarial, and three-seed certification if the same exact repaired host passes every quality and speed gate.
execution_and_stop_rule.failure: If the repaired host fails ABI/general quality or sustained speed, preserve it as negative evidence and do not sweep steps, learning rates, horizons, or nearby variants.

claim_boundary: The parent trajectories teach autonomous English realization to already-installed small cakes. They do not import external knowledge, do not retrain the English transformer, and do not establish global minimum data.
